name: Blue Spot Cuts
description: Object ball pinned to the blue spot (grid row 32 = z=0, col 5 = x=0); cue ball moves around it so every exercise is a different cut angle at the same real-world spot. Grid: rows step 0.0525m (one ball diameter), cols step 0.146m (half the D radius, so green/yellow still land exactly) -- see assets/puzzles/grid.json.
